# LootRollMover

## [v8.0](https://github.com/Xruptor/LootRollMover/tree/v8.0) (2026-04-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Xruptor/LootRollMover/compare/v7.9...v8.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Xruptor/LootRollMover/releases)

- Added a Bonus Roll Anchor and few Fixes  
    * Fixed an issue where the Bonus Roll Frame was being overlapped over the regular Loot Frame.  This shouldn't be happening, but it seems the anchor positions have been separated by Blizzard.  So to fix this I've added a new Bonus Roll Anchor that you can move around.  (Fixes #19)  
    * I also discovered some positioning bugs that weren't being fired on loot shown.  This has been fixed.  
    * Fixed an issue where after resetting or repositioning, it didn't always call the save layout function.  
    * Cleaned up some code that was old and redundant.
